title: 法巴策略师：基本面未承压，AI模型差距缩小但仍有距离
speaker: Jason Louis

segments.en: as you reported earlier there's some kind of government meeting that is trying to stabilize the market a little bit but ultimately I think it has to boil down to fundamental. When we look at the fundamental so far all the companies that have reported their earnings has been quite good.
segments.zh: 正如你之前报道的，有政府会议试图稳定市场，但最终还是要看基本面。目前公布业绩的公司表现相当不错。

segments.en: Now of course investors are always trying to be forward looking but so far we have not seen enough definitive evidence how this whole dynamic will shift. What we do know is that it seems that based on the latest reporting the gap between the China model and perhaps the frontier model are shrinking but they're still a gap.
segments.zh: 投资者总是向前看，但迄今尚无足够证据表明格局将如何转变。我们知道的是，根据最新报告，中国模型与前沿模型的差距在缩小，但仍有差距。

segments.en: So the problem is that okay how much of a gap is being already priced into the market but not just in Asia across the Asia technology complex as well.
segments.zh: 问题在于，市场已经定价了多少差距？这不仅限于亚洲，而是整个亚洲科技板块。
